relevant_laws.quote: The driver of a vehicle within a business or residence district emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision, and upon entering the roadway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on said roadway.
relevant_laws.notes: Road-to-driveway travel can cross the sidewalk area in a residence district. The frozen exit_road maneuver does not establish the separate upon-entering-roadway duty.
